ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey interior pixels to low-intensity black perimeter and linear scar pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad central high-intensity white/grey zones spanning the interior of both lobes, bounded by thick low-intensity black bands along the trailing edges and distal tips. The white field is heavily intersected by dark-value linear features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression at the center; the calculated angle between the inner lobe margins is approximately 40-45 degrees with significant depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; the left lobe (viewer left) shows higher frequency peaks, while the right lobe displays broader, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the center, sweeping outward to tapered, pointed tips; the trajectory of the left lobe exhibits a more pronounced upward curve compared to the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters indicating barnacle colonization localized on the far distal tip of the left lobe; smaller isolated white focal points along the black margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, multi-directional network of dark linear disruptions (rake marks) covering the majority of the light-colored ventral surface on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel and intersecting dark lines) across the ventral surface; significant white calcified clusters (barnacles) on the outer edge of the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast white linear mark resembling a 'slash' on the far right tip, cutting through the black border area.
